name: Regime-armed momentum with ADX trend-quality confirm (gate is regime, not the ADX filter)
rationale: THESIS: Two failure modes kill plain momentum — wrong macro tape (risk-off) and chop (no real trend, just whipsaw). I separate them: macro_regime (BOUNDED composite) is the ORTHOGONAL macro gate that says 'risk premia are paid', and adx (BOUNDED, level-bounded directional strength) is the trend-QUALITY confirm that says 'this is a real trend not noise'. The claim under test is that the macro gate carries information BEYOND trend strength — the regime tells you whether to trust the trend at all. Entry: macro_regime>floor AND adx>adx_floor AND ret_Nd>mom_floor. DISCONFIRMER: run the SAME entry with macro_regime DROPPED but adx kept (trend-quality-only momentum). If ADX-gated momentum reproduces the regime+ADX net-of-fee Sharpe, the macro gate is redundant to a pure trend-strength filter and adds no orthogonal macro info — falsified. The macro gate must add incremental net edge over the ADX-only version.
catalyst: Risk-on macro regime co-occurs with a high-ADX real trend and positive ret_Nd — the macro window arms a momentum entry that already passed a trend-quality screen.
